title: Smoked Wild Boar (Hog) Burgers (225°F)
ingredients: 1.5 lbs ground wild boar (hog) — optionally blended with 3 oz finely minced bacon for richness
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar or Worcestershire sauce
1 tsp dried sage, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 1.5 tsp kosher salt, 1 tsp black pepper
4 slices Gruyère, Gouda, or sharp cheddar cheese
4 toasted brioche or pretzel buns, apple-cabbage slaw or caramelized onions, and whole-grain mustard mayo
instructions: Preheat smoker to 225°F (107°C) with apple or hickory wood.
Combine ground wild boar (and optional minced bacon) with apple cider vinegar, sage, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Shape into 4 patties.
Smoke at 225°F for 45–50 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F, then sear over high heat for 1–2 minutes per side until 155–160°F internal.
Top with Gruyère or sharp cheddar to melt, and serve on toasted buns with whole-grain mustard mayo and caramelized onions.
sourceTitle: Broken Arrow Ranch · Smoked Wild Boar Burgers
